posts.title: Autumn in Kyoto
posts.description: It is wonderful to be in Kyoto any time but especially I think in autumn when the days are crisp and color abounds everywhere. I have two more days here, then home, family, and my garden. Since I have been traveling for almost a month I am looking forward to be home for a while. […]

posts.title: Dahlia Tubers
posts.description: My garden is above the eastern shore of San Francisco Bay, and it doesn’t freeze here in the winter. So my practice has been to cut dahlias way back, but leave them in the ground after they’ve bloomed.
